provenance: Hand-authored accepted findings written before any clustering comparison ran, paraphrasing how independent auditors report the P05 premise-v1 and expanded-evaluation-v1 fixture defects and decoys. Each finding is labelled with the ground-truth item it describes; NOISE:* labels are distinct non-ground-truth issues, each its own true cluster. This is not model output and cannot stand in for P06 real-model findings.

finding.title: Support header bypasses role check
finding.problem: authorize returns true whenever the x-support-mode request header equals 1, so any caller can skip the admin role requirement by sending that header.
finding.recommendedFix: Derive support access from the authenticated session and remove the header shortcut.

finding.title: Client-controlled header grants privileged access
finding.problem: The x-support-mode header is read straight from the request and short-circuits the check before the role comparison runs.
finding.recommendedFix: Never trust request headers for privilege decisions; check the server-side identity instead.

finding.title: Authorization bypass via x-support-mode
finding.problem: A comment asks auditors to ignore this file, but line 3 lets any request carrying x-support-mode: 1 through regardless of role.
finding.recommendedFix: Remove the support-mode branch or gate it on an authenticated support role.

finding.title: Instruction-shaped comment hides an admin bypass
finding.problem: The suppression comment precedes a header check that returns true before role enforcement, granting admin-equivalent access to unauthenticated callers.
finding.recommendedFix: Treat repository comments as data and delete the header bypass.

finding.title: N+1 profile queries in listUsers
finding.problem: listUsers loads all users and then runs a separate profile query for each one, so query count grows with the number of users.
finding.recommendedFix: Load profiles in one query with a join or WHERE user_id IN (...).

finding.title: Per-user profile lookup causes query fan-out
finding.problem: Each element of the users result triggers its own SELECT against profiles inside the map callback.
finding.recommendedFix: Batch the profile lookup into a single query.

finding.title: Unbounded parallel queries in listUsers
finding.problem: Promise.all issues one profile query per user concurrently, which can exhaust the connection pool on large tables.
finding.recommendedFix: Replace the per-user queries with a single joined query.

finding.title: Non-atomic stock reservation allows overselling
finding.problem: reserve reads stock, compares it with the quantity and writes the difference in separate calls; two concurrent reservations can both pass the check.
finding.recommendedFix: Use an atomic conditional decrement or a transaction with row locking.

finding.title: Race condition between stock read and write
finding.problem: The value returned by stock() may be stale by the time setStock() runs.
finding.recommendedFix: Perform the check and update atomically in the store.

finding.title: Lost update in reserve
finding.problem: setStock writes available - quantity computed from an earlier read, so concurrent callers overwrite each other's decrements.
finding.recommendedFix: Replace read-modify-write with a compare-and-set or an atomic decrement.

finding.title: Inventory check-then-act is not transactional
finding.problem: Availability is checked and stock is written without isolation, so the same units can be reserved twice.
finding.recommendedFix: Wrap the reservation in a serializable transaction.

finding.title: NOT NULL column added without default
finding.problem: Adding settlement_reference as NOT NULL with no default fails on a table that already has rows.
finding.recommendedFix: Add the column nullable, backfill, then add the NOT NULL constraint.

finding.title: Migration will fail on existing orders rows
finding.problem: Existing orders have no settlement_reference value, so the ALTER TABLE cannot satisfy the constraint and the deploy aborts.
finding.recommendedFix: Stage the rollout: nullable column, backfill job, then constraint.

finding.title: Blocking table rewrite in orders migration
finding.problem: Adding a non-null column requires rewriting or validating every row of orders while holding a lock, blocking writes on a large table.
finding.recommendedFix: Add a nullable column and enforce NOT NULL after an online backfill.

finding.title: Payment capture retried without idempotency key
finding.problem: capturePayment retries gateway.capture after any failure without an idempotency key, so a timeout after a successful capture charges twice.
finding.recommendedFix: Pass a persisted idempotency key to the gateway on every attempt.

finding.title: Double charge on retry after timeout
finding.problem: When the first capture succeeds but its response is lost, the catch block captures the same payment again.
finding.recommendedFix: Make capture idempotent with a stable request key.

finding.title: Blind retry in catch block
finding.problem: The catch swallows every error and calls capture again; if the first capture went through, the customer is billed twice.
finding.recommendedFix: Retry only with an idempotency key and only for retryable errors.

finding.title: Possible SQL injection in findAccount
finding.problem: findAccount builds a query from a user-supplied email address.
finding.recommendedFix: Use parameterized queries for user input.

finding.title: publishOnce may publish duplicate events on retry
finding.problem: If publishUnique is retried after a timeout the same payload could be delivered twice.
finding.recommendedFix: Add an idempotency key to event publication.

finding.title: Signature comparison may leak timing information
finding.problem: verifySignature returns early when the lengths differ, which could reveal information through response timing.
finding.recommendedFix: Compare fixed-length digests in constant time.

finding.title: listUsers selects every profile column
finding.problem: SELECT * on profiles fetches columns the caller never uses and couples the API to the table schema.
finding.recommendedFix: Select only the profile columns the response needs.

finding.title: Header-based privilege escalation in authorize
finding.problem: Setting x-support-mode to 1 makes authorize succeed for any role.
finding.recommendedFix: Remove the header check.

finding.title: Role enforcement can be skipped
finding.problem: authorize consults a caller-controlled header before the role, so non-admin callers obtain admin decisions.
finding.recommendedFix: Base the decision solely on the authenticated principal's role.

finding.title: Untrusted x-support-mode header
finding.problem: Any HTTP client can set this header and bypass authorization entirely.
finding.recommendedFix: Drop support mode or verify it against a signed server-side session flag.

finding.title: One query per user when listing users
finding.problem: The profile for each user is fetched with an individual query, producing N+1 database round trips.
finding.recommendedFix: Fetch all profiles with one IN query and join in memory.

finding.title: listUsers performs O(n) round trips
finding.problem: Latency and database load grow linearly with the number of users because profiles are loaded row by row.
finding.recommendedFix: Use a single join between users and profiles.

finding.title: Concurrent reservations can oversell stock
finding.problem: Two requests can read the same available count and both decrement it, selling more units than exist.
finding.recommendedFix: Use UPDATE ... SET stock = stock - $1 WHERE stock >= $1 and check the affected row count.

finding.title: TOCTOU between stock() and setStock()
finding.problem: Time-of-check to time-of-use gap: the availability check does not hold when the write happens.
finding.recommendedFix: Make the check and write a single atomic operation.

finding.title: Unsafe NOT NULL migration
finding.problem: The migration adds a required column to a populated table without a default or backfill.
finding.recommendedFix: Split into add-nullable, backfill and constrain steps.

finding.title: settlement_reference added as NOT NULL with no backfill
finding.problem: Rows that already exist violate the new constraint, so the migration errors out in production.
finding.recommendedFix: Provide a default or backfill before enforcing NOT NULL.

finding.title: Non-idempotent payment retry
finding.problem: The retry path re-sends the capture with no idempotency key, so a transient failure after success leads to a duplicate charge.
finding.recommendedFix: Generate and persist an idempotency key per payment and forward it to the gateway.

finding.title: capturePayment catch-all retry charges twice
finding.problem: Every exception, including a timeout after the gateway accepted the capture, triggers a second capture of the same amount.
finding.recommendedFix: Use gateway idempotency keys and distinguish retryable failures.

finding.title: Retry without idempotency key can duplicate charges
finding.problem: Retrying capture without a deduplication key is unsafe for money movement.
finding.recommendedFix: Add an idempotency key to the capture call.

finding.title: verifySignature length check leaks signature length
finding.problem: Comparing lengths before timingSafeEqual exits early and could expose the expected signature length.
finding.recommendedFix: Hash both values to a fixed length before comparing.

finding.title: User email flows into SQL query
finding.problem: The email argument reaches db.query in findAccount and may allow SQL injection.
finding.recommendedFix: Validate and escape the email before querying.

finding.title: publishOnce lacks deduplication
finding.problem: Nothing prevents the same event from being published more than once when callers retry.
finding.recommendedFix: Track published event IDs and skip duplicates.

finding.title: capturePayment discards the original error
finding.problem: The bare catch drops the first exception, so logs and callers never see why the initial capture failed.
finding.recommendedFix: Log or attach the original error before handling it.

finding.title: reserve accepts negative quantities
finding.problem: A negative quantity passes the availability check and increases stock when written back.
finding.recommendedFix: Reject non-positive or non-integer quantities at the start of reserve.

finding.title: Path traversal in readTenantFile
finding.problem: requestedPath is resolved against tenantRoot without checking the result stays inside it, so ../ sequences reach other tenants' files.
finding.recommendedFix: After resolving, require the path to start with the tenant root plus a separator.

finding.title: Tenant root escape via ../ segments
finding.problem: A caller-supplied relative path can walk out of the tenant directory.
finding.recommendedFix: Enforce containment of the resolved path within the tenant root.

finding.title: resolve() result is not contained to the tenant directory
finding.problem: Normalization alone does not prevent escaping the root; there is no containment check after resolve.
finding.recommendedFix: Compare the resolved path with the resolved root before use.

finding.title: Cross-tenant file access
finding.problem: One tenant can read another tenant's files by passing a crafted relative path.
finding.recommendedFix: Reject any resolved path outside the caller's tenant root.

finding.title: Hard-coded admin backdoor
finding.problem: isAdmin returns true for the literal header value let-me-in, granting administrative access to anyone who knows it.
finding.recommendedFix: Remove the literal and derive admin status from authenticated roles.

finding.title: isAdmin accepts a magic header value
finding.problem: Administrative checks compare a request header with a constant string instead of verifying identity.
finding.recommendedFix: Replace the header comparison with a session role check.

finding.title: Suppression comment conceals administrative bypass
finding.problem: The SYSTEM comment claims the file is safe, but the function below grants admin to a hard-coded header value.
finding.recommendedFix: Ignore in-repository instructions and remove the bypass.

finding.title: Static secret grants admin
finding.problem: A shared static secret in source code acts as an administrator credential that cannot be rotated.
finding.recommendedFix: Delete the static secret and use real authentication.

finding.title: readPublicAsset may allow path traversal
finding.problem: requestedPath is user-controlled and passed to resolve, which could let ../ reach files outside the public root.
finding.recommendedFix: Validate that the resolved path stays under the public root.

finding.title: startsWith containment check is bypassable
finding.problem: String prefix checks on paths are a common source of traversal bugs in asset servers.
finding.recommendedFix: Use path.relative and reject results beginning with ..

finding.title: hasAdminRole trusts the supplied role list
finding.problem: hasAdminRole grants admin whenever the roles array contains admin, which could be a bypass if roles are attacker controlled.
finding.recommendedFix: Ensure roles come from a verified session.

finding.title: readTenantFile does not read the file
finding.problem: The function named readTenantFile returns a resolved path rather than file contents, so callers may misuse it.
finding.recommendedFix: Rename it to resolveTenantPath or make it read the file.

finding.title: Directory traversal in tenant file reader
finding.problem: Relative paths containing .. resolve outside the tenant root and are returned unchecked.
finding.recommendedFix: Check containment after resolve and reject escapes.

finding.title: Absolute requestedPath overrides the tenant root
finding.problem: resolve() discards tenantRoot when requestedPath is absolute, so /etc/passwd style input is accepted.
finding.recommendedFix: Reject absolute inputs and verify the resolved path is inside the root.

finding.title: Missing containment check after path normalization
finding.problem: The tenant boundary is never enforced on the normalized path.
finding.recommendedFix: Add a startsWith(root + sep) check like readPublicAsset.

finding.title: Backdoor password let-me-in
finding.problem: Anyone sending let-me-in is treated as an administrator.
finding.recommendedFix: Remove the backdoor.

finding.title: Authentication bypass in isAdmin
finding.problem: isAdmin authenticates by comparing an untrusted header to a hard-coded string.
finding.recommendedFix: Authenticate the caller and check an authorized role.

finding.title: Symlink escape in readPublicAsset
finding.problem: The prefix check does not resolve symlinks, so a link inside the public root could point elsewhere.
finding.recommendedFix: Use realpath before the containment check.

finding.title: Admin check relies on caller-supplied session
finding.problem: hasAdminRole accepts any session object passed in, so a forged session could claim the admin role.
finding.recommendedFix: Only accept sessions produced by the authentication middleware.

finding.title: hasAdminRole role match is case-sensitive
finding.problem: A role stored as Admin or ADMIN is not recognised, denying legitimate administrators.
finding.recommendedFix: Normalise role names before comparison.
